title: The film about Sam Altman has been dropped by Amazon MGM
brief: Luca Guadagnino's film "Artificial," starring Andrew Garfield as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, has been dropped by Amazon MGM after a year in development. The movie chronicled Altman's five-day termination and reinstatement as CEO in 2023 and featured a cast including Monica Barbaro as Mira Murati and Ike Barinholtz as Elon Musk.
